steps.title: Roll minion damage and life
steps.action: Buy the rare Leviathan Gauntlets with exactly 34% fractured Chaos Resistance; no free self-fracture is assumed. Repeat Deafening Essence of Fear.
steps.continueWhen: 100+ life, essence minion damage and an open suffix compatible with crafted Strength.
steps.failureAction: Pay another Fear; fracture remains, other explicit modifiers and previous bench craft are lost. Do not Scour between direct essence rerolls.

steps.title: Craft Strength
steps.failureAction: If native Strength blocks the craft, reject/reroll the core; do not silently change the selected target.

steps.title: Roll minion implicit
steps.action: Use Lesser Eldritch Embers until unconditional Minions deal 14–16% increased Damage.
steps.continueWhen: Unconditional minion damage implicit at least 14%.
steps.failureAction: Repeat Embers. This is a Lesser implicit target, not the unverified 20–22% upgrade.
